title: Step 2 - Troubleshooting Naive Bayes Classification: Empty Prediction Vectors

cues.en: -: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: And that's all.
cues.zh: 就這樣。

cues.en: You will see that it will work perfectly well.
cues.zh: 你會看到它能順利運作。

cues.en: So I'll show you right now.
cues.zh: 馬上展示。

cues.en: Let's select what's above which is all the pre-processing steps.
cues.zh: 選取上方所有前處理步驟。

cues.en: So command and control plus enter to execute.
cues.zh: 按 Command 或 Control + Enter 執行。

cues.en: All right, pre-processing, well done.
cues.zh: 好，前處理完成。

cues.en: We are good to go.
cues.zh: 可以繼續了。

cues.en: And now we can create our classifier.
cues.zh: 現在建立分類器。

cues.en: So yes, let's do this.
cues.zh: 來做。

cues.en: If your E 10 71 package is not selected you need to select that as well.
cues.zh: 如果 e1071 套件還沒勾選，也需要選取這一行。

cues.en: So command control plus enter to execute.
cues.zh: 按 Command 或 Control + Enter 執行。

cues.en: And here is our classifier.
cues.zh: 這就是分類器。

cues.en: Awesome. So as you can see it works perfect.
cues.zh: 很棒，可以看到正常運作。

cues.en: Well, the classifier is well created using only those two information.
cues.zh: 只用這兩項資訊，分類器就成功建立。

cues.en: And when you think about it well this is all we need to train a classifier because we need the information of the independent variables and the information of the dependent variable
cues.zh: 想想其實訓練分類器只需要這些，因為需要自變數資訊與應變數資訊，

cues.en: so that it can learn the correlations between the independent variables and the dependent variable.
cues.zh: 才能學習自變數與應變數之間的關聯。

cues.en: All right, so that makes sense.
cues.zh: 好，很合理。

cues.en: And now we can create our vector of prediction y_pred using the predict function on our classifier and on our new data which is the test set.
cues.zh: 現在可以用 predict 函式，對 classifier 與新資料 test_set，建立預測向量 y_pred。

cues.en: So here we go.
cues.zh: 來做。

cues.en: Y_pred is created.
cues.zh: y_pred 建立了。

cues.en: Let's have a quick look.
cues.zh: 快速看一下。

cues.en: Y_pred. So for the first time we are obtaining something here.
cues.zh: y_pred，這次第一次得到這樣的內容。

cues.en: Remember before when we entered y_pred in the console we had all the predictions listed in the console but here we have this factor zero here.
cues.zh: 記得之前在主控台輸入 y_pred，都會列出所有預測，但這裡是 factor(0)。

cues.en: So that means that y_pred is a vector of factors, but with no factor.
cues.zh: 意思是 y_pred 是因子向量，卻沒有任何因子。

cues.en: So it's basically an empty vector.
cues.zh: 基本上是空向量。

cues.en: And that is because the naive bayes function of the E 10 71 library didn't recognize our dependent variable vector purchased as a categorical variable with zero and one factors.
cues.zh: 原因是 e1071 函式庫的 naiveBayes 函式，沒有把應變數向量 Purchased 辨識成具有 0 與 1 因子的類別變數。

cues.en: So far, the libraries and functions we've been using recognized the dependent variable as factors.
cues.zh: 之前使用的函式庫與函式，都把應變數辨識成因子。

cues.en: So we didn't have any issues with our predictions and we didn't have to encode the dependent variable purchased as factors.
cues.zh: 所以預測沒有問題，也不需要把應變數 Purchased 編碼成因子。

cues.en: But here with naive bayes, it's not the case.
cues.zh: 但這裡樸素貝氏不同。

cues.en: It doesn't recognize the dependent variable purchased as factors.
cues.zh: 它沒有把應變數 Purchased 辨識成因子。

cues.en: So we need to encode it as factors because as you can see if we try to compute the confusion matrix below we will get this following error message.
cues.zh: 因此必須編碼成因子。可以看到，若試著計算下方混淆矩陣，就會得到以下錯誤訊息。

cues.en: All arguments must have the same length.
cues.zh: 所有引數的長度必須相同。

cues.en: Well, yes, indeed we have a problem because the two arguments here are test set three, that is the third column purchased of the test set, and then y_pred.
cues.zh: 是的，確實有問題，因為兩個引數是 test_set 的第三欄，也就是 Purchased，以及 y_pred。

cues.en: So since test_set three has length a hundred and y_pred has length zero because it's an empty vector with no factors, then obviously we cannot compute
cues.zh: test_set 第三欄長度是一百，y_pred 長度是零，因為是沒有因子的空向量，所以顯然無法計算

cues.en: any confusion matrix.
cues.zh: 混淆矩陣。

cues.en: So what we need to do is to jump back up to the pre-processing, first step, to encode our dependent variable purchased as factors.
cues.zh: 要做的就是回到上方前處理的第一步，把應變數 Purchased 編碼成因子。

cues.en: Then the naive bayes function will recognize the dependent variable as factors and will perfectly be able to create a classifier that will allow the
cues.zh: 這樣 naiveBayes 函式就能把應變數辨識成因子，成功建立分類器，讓

cues.en: predict function to return the expected vector of predictions y_pred.
cues.zh: predict 函式回傳預期的預測向量 y_pred。

cues.en: So it's great that you see this error because this is a classic error in machine learning and R.
cues.zh: 很好，讓你看到這個錯誤，因為這是機器學習與 R 中常見的錯誤。

cues.en: And that way from now on, you will make this error in the future, or if you make it, you'll know how to fix it.
cues.zh: 這樣未來就不會再犯，或者犯了也知道如何修正。

cues.en: So let's do it right now.
cues.zh: 現在就做。

cues.en: Let's add a new code section here and let's call it encoding the target feature as factor.
cues.zh: 加一個新的程式碼區段，叫做 Encoding the target feature as factor。

cues.en: All right, and now let's factorize our column purchased.
cues.zh: 好，現在把 Purchased 欄轉成因子。

cues.en: Okay, let's do this.
cues.zh: 來做。

cues.en: So we will take it from start.
cues.zh: 從最開始處理。

cues.en: That means that we will take the purchased dependent variable column of the data dataset, and then we will recompute all of these to set this purchase column everywhere
cues.zh: 意思是取 dataset 資料集中的應變數 Purchased 欄，再重新計算所有這些內容，讓每個資料集中的 Purchased 欄

cues.en: for all our sets.
cues.zh: 都套用這個設定。

cues.en: That is a training set and the test set.
cues.zh: 也就是訓練集與測試集。

cues.en: Okay, so we're gonna take our last column from our dataset.
cues.zh: 好，所以先取資料集最後一欄。

cues.en: So we're gonna type dataset dollar purchased right equals factor, and in parenthesis data set.
cues.zh: 輸入 dataset$Purchased，等於 factor，小括號中輸入 dataset。

cues.en: And then again, we're taking the purchased column that is the dependent variable column of our data set.
cues.zh: 再次取 Purchased 欄，也就是資料集的應變數欄。

cues.en: So again, we're taking the dollar sign here and purchased to take this column.
cues.zh: 一樣用錢號與 Purchased 取得此欄。

cues.en: And then here we will just specify the levels or our levels are C zero and one.
cues.zh: 這裡再指定 levels，也就是 c(0, 1)。

cues.en: All right?
cues.zh: 好嗎？

cues.en: And that's it.
cues.zh: 就這樣。

cues.en: That's how you encode your dependent variable column purchased into factors.
cues.zh: 這就是把應變數 Purchased 欄編碼成因子的方式。

cues.en: All right, so we're gonna start from scratch now.
cues.zh: 好，現在從頭開始。

cues.en: So to do this, we can clear everything.
cues.zh: 可以先清空所有內容。

cues.en: So that's what we're going to do, clear everything here.
cues.zh: 所以現在清除這裡所有東西。

cues.en: So we're clearing the data, clearing the script here.
cues.zh: 清除資料，清除這裡的內容。

cues.en: So I'm pressing control L to clear.
cues.zh: 按 Control + L 清空。

cues.en: And that's it.
cues.zh: 就這樣。
